jobs.occupation: iDSB - International German School Brussels - Head of IT Coordination & Administration
jobs.description:
The purpose of this position is to ensure the daily operation, proper maintenance and development of information and communication systems in order to support a high-quality edcuation and an efficient administration of the school. This role becomes more important over time. A high quality IT infrastructure and very good user experience are distinction criteria for the school and therefore a leverage to reach our strategic long term objectives.

The position holder on the one hand needs to be capable of supporting the school staff with a clientoriented mindset on all IT related issues. On the other hand she/he needs to proactively advise on improvements of the IT Infrastructure, support the decision making process and implement such new solutions.
Your tasks (list is not exhaustive)

• Responsible for the daily operation of the School's Information- and Communication Infrastructure

• Maintenance of all Hard- and Software components used in the school (Server, Antivirus, Backups, wired and wireless networks, Firewalls, video conference equipment, endpoints, telephony).

• Ensure the security of all IT systems (apply security patches, manage configurations, ensure Anti-virus and other security updates)

• Ensure all required IT services are available during school hours (7:30 - 17:30) and on request also outside school hours through pro-active maintenance and SWIFT and effective troubleshooting

• Manage the school provided Mobile devices (laptops, tablets, smartphones, mobile phones)

• Management of Contracts: Software Licenses, Maintenance agreements, IT related leasing

• Installation of new systems (including testing, appropriate communication, training etc.)

• Assure connection to external specialists and leverage them as appropriate for the school

• User access Management (including setting up accounts for new users etc.)

• Creation and maintenance of complete documentation of all ICT systems (e.g. network structure, security architecture, overview of servers in operation, network components, end devices such as PCs, tablets, projectors, smartboards, monitors, ...)

• Proactively advise on system changes or new products, which could improve the IT landscape of the school, both in the area of software as well as Hardware

• Monitor and actively advise on developments in the educational environment (Germany, Belgium) as far as Technology in schools is concerned

• Act as an advisor on general IT topics for the school's headmaster and the administrative board

Organization / exposure

• The jobholder reports to the Head of Administration of the School.

• The position is complemented by a junior IT expert, who would report to the jobholder.

• Day-to-day contact with Teachers, administrative staff and students. Occasional contact with external stakeholders (Parents, Administration Board).

• Motivated IT allrounder with 3-5 years relevant experience

• Expertise in providing 1st Level support for a small to medium organization

• Expertise in Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Windows 10 and network technology

• Experience with selection and implementation of new hard- or software.

• Able to communicate with partners with limited IT background when proposing new solutions or changes to existing solutions

• Ideally some project management experience

• Proactivity - you find issues before they find you, eager to push things forward

• Problem Solving Skills

• Hands-on activities are your thing

• Client oriented mindset; self-organized but also a teamplayer

• Ability to prioritise; Adherence to deadlines

• Languages: solid knowledge of English; basic German; French and / or Dutch desirable but not mandatory

For an international company active in the automotive sector, we are looking for a passionate and proactive Communication Officer. The company specializes in innovative vehicle solutions and operates across several international markets.

You will join an international environment where communication plays an important role in showcasing the company's expertise, projects and solutions. You will work closely with different teams and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to life.

Jobomschrijving

Your responsibilities

• You develop and create a wide range of communication materials, including brochures, presentations, newsletters, product content and social media posts.
• You manage the company's social media channels and create engaging photo and video content, taking ownership of the entire process from the initial idea to publication.
• You coordinate website content, translate technical information into accessible communication and ensure a consistent brand identity across all channels.
• You work closely with marketing, sales, operations and international colleagues, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve the company's communication and digital presence.

Your profile

• You have at least a first experience in a general communication or marketing role and are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.

• You have experience with social media, graphic content and photo and video editing. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, Lightroom and CapCut is a plus.
• You are curious about digital communication and new technologies, and enjoy finding ways to improve existing processes and content.
• You have a valid driving licence (B) and are willing to travel between the Belgian offices in Antwerp and Brussels and occasionally abroad. You are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow and make a real impact.

Joining our organization means becoming part of an international and dynamic retail environment.

For an international company active in the medical sector, we are looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist to support the development and execution of digital marketing activities across the Benelux region.

The company develops and distributes high-quality medical products and solutions to healthcare professionals worldwide. With a strong international presence, the organization combines innovation, quality and customer focus with a commitment to employee development and collaboration.

Jobomschrijving

The roleAs a Digital Marketing Specialist, you will be responsible for implementing digital marketing campaigns and supporting local marketing initiatives across the Benelux. You will work closely with the Marketing Manager to translate the marketing strategy into impactful campaigns that increase brand awareness, engage healthcare professionals and support commercial objectives.

Your responsibilities:

• Digital campaigns & content: Develop and coordinate digital campaigns across social media, newsletters, websites and external platforms, ensuring engaging and relevant content for the target audience.
• Local marketing activation: Adapt international marketing initiatives to local market needs and support the communication of promotions, events and webinars.
• Website & webshop management: Ensure that online content, product information and promotional activities are accurate and up to date.
• Performance analysis: Monitor campaign performance through relevant KPIs, report on results and identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.

• You are fluent in French and English. A basic knowledge of Dutch is an asset.
• You have experience with digital campaigns and content creation. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, HubSpot or Hootsuite is a plus.
• Experience managing websites or webshops is an advantage.
• You are organized, proactive and hands-on, with the ability to manage projects independently and handle multiple priorities.
• You have strong communication skills, an analytical mindset and a willingness to learn.

TPCE (Toyota Parts Centre Europe) is het Europees Distributiecentrum van Toyota. Het levert Toyota & Lexus– onderdelen aan Europese distributeurs. Verder belevert Toyota ook rechtstreeks aan garages/dealers in België, Luxemburg, Nederland, Duitsland en Noord – Frankrijk. In Diest worden de ingevoerde auto – onderdelen van Toyota en Lexus gestockeerd en worden de bestellingen voor de dealers en distributeurs klaargemaakt en verzonden. TPCE is een geautomatiseerd verdeelcentrum van auto – onderdelen.

Jobomschrijving

Tasks & Responsibilities
	
• Monitor supplier compliance with the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).	
• Track project progress and ensure deadlines are met.	
• Organize and facilitate online meetings with suppliers.	
• Explain PPWR requirements, compliance expectations, and supplier responsibilities.	
• Discuss and clarify different packaging types and packaging processes.	
• Coordinate implementation plans and define target dates.	
• Follow up on corrective actions and ensure timely execution.	
• Monitor progress, milestones, and supplier commitments.	
• Prepare weekly compliance reports for management.	
• Identify risks, bottlenecks, and areas requiring escalation.	
• Conduct audits and inspections within warehouse operations.	
• Verify manufacturer labels and packaging compliance.	
• Ensure packaging and labeling processes meet PPWR requirements and internal standards.	
• Collaborate with internal departments and external suppliers.	
• Contribute to a sustainable, compliant, and efficient supply chain.	
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization projects.

Profile
	
• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.	
• Experience with sustainable packaging solutions is an asset.	
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.	
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and SharePoint.	
• Knowledge of Access and Power BI is a plus.	
• Able to manage multiple suppliers, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.	
• Strong planning, organizational, and prioritization skills.	
• Accurate, structured, and detail-oriented.	
• Able to work independently while maintaining a proactive approach.	
• Analytical and capable of making fact-based decisions.	
• Strong follow-up skills and a results-driven mindset.	
• Positive attitude combined with a strong work ethic.	
• Team player who values collaboration and respect.	
• Eager to learn and continuously improve processes.
